title: KHR_animation_reference_pose glTF Animation Extension
description: glTF extension that marks an animation as a canonical reference (rest) pose, usable as the baseline for additive animations and for retargeting.

poseType.description: The semantic classification of this reference pose. Open-ended; 'rest' is the neutral default. 'TPose'/'APose'/'IPose' are common humanoid conventions but are not required.
